verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a prompt-driven design/prototyping generator with only basic layout controls (drag, resize, align, sliders for spacing/color) — there is no evidence of pen/path vector editing, boolean path operations, or precision alignment tooling akin to professional vector editors. Community feedback even notes the underlying output is HTML/CSS/JS, not vector paths, and code is not maintainable, reinforcing it's not a vector design tool. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The rationale concedes the evidence covers only the alignment part; drag/resize/align layout controls are not pen/path editing or boolean operations, and the only vector-specific community report documents the absence of geometry control.
